Meters from the lowest ground to the highest (the topo lines are drawn every few meters of it) (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Tiles; roughly how wide hills and valleys are (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
0-1; how much small bumps ride on the big hills (0.3 = smooth and rolling; 0.7 = rugged) (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Broad dips pressed into the ground; with Water on most hold a lake (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Meters; a hollow shallower than this (floor to brim) stays dry (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Water on only: how full each hollow gets, from its floor (0%) to the brim where it would spill (100%); 0% = no lakes (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Water on only: tiles of ground that must drain through a spot before it runs as a river (twice as wide past four times this); 0 = no rivers (a range: each world draws its own value from it)
Tiles; a river is crossed by a land bridge (a ford) about this often along its length
Tiles; roughly how wide the largest meadows are
Meadows only: how many colonies the starting bunnies live in
Meadows only: how many packs the starting wolves run in
Meadows only: warren holes dug at each colony before its bunnies settle; Scatter has none
A new hole is dug only within this many tiles of an existing hole (unless no hole is within HoleRange)
A hole no bunny has stood on for this long collapses into bare ground
Create/Destroy tab: the default radius of the nuke (the Radius slider overrides it; 0-100); a nuke destroys everything within this many tiles (a circle) of where it lands
Create/Destroy tab: days the ground at a nuke's center stays scorched (bare: nothing grows or is dug there); it shortens toward the rim so the crater greens from its edges
Create/Destroy tab: the default radius in tiles of the grass/rabbit/wolf/human brush (0 = one tile; the Radius slider overrides it per mode)
Blank = new random seed each run; the seed used is shown on screen so you can paste it here to replay that start
Create/Destroy tab: painting past this many animals in total asks first since big crowds slow the sim down on many devices (the benchmark shows smooth to about 32000 animals on a Mac; phones vary)
